items.exampleEn: We were thankful that nobody was hurt.
items.exampleZh: 沒有人受傷，我們心存感激。

items.exampleEn: Our neighbors looked annoyed about the noise.

items.audioEn: I was really annoyed. My brother used my computer without asking.
items.audioZh: 我真的很惱火，我的兄弟沒問就用了我的電腦。
options: The brother ate all the cake in the fridge
The computer was used without permission
The brother asked to use the computer

items.sentenceEn: The firefighters were courageous and calm.

items.stemEn: I'm ____ for all the help you gave me.
items.stemZh: 我很感謝你給我的所有幫助。

items.stemEn: My grandma's old letters are something I will always ____.
items.stemZh: 奶奶的舊信是我會永遠珍惜的東西。

items.passageEn: Last year, my school's basketball team lost every game, and many people said we were hopeless. Our coach never got annoyed. He always spoke to us politely and told us to be courageous. Before the final game, he said, "Don't worry about disappointing anyone. Just enjoy the game." During the game, a little boy in the crowd watched us curiously. We played boldly and won by one point! After the game, the boy said he wanted to play basketball, too. I'm thankful for that season, and I will always cherish those memories.
items.passageZh: 去年，我們學校的籃球隊每場比賽都輸，很多人說我們毫無希望。我們的教練從不惱怒。他總是很有禮貌地跟我們說話，要我們勇敢。最後一場比賽前，他說：「別怕讓任何人失望，好好享受比賽就好。」比賽時，觀眾席上一個小男孩好奇地看著我們。我們大膽地打，以一分之差贏了！比賽結束後，那個男孩說他也想打籃球。我很感謝那個球季，也會永遠珍惜那些回憶。

questions.questionZh: 教練在最後一場比賽前說了什麼？
options: 別怕讓人失望，好好享受比賽

questions.questionZh: 比賽結束後，小男孩說了什麼？
